posts.text:
This President has the audacity to spend YOUR hard-earned money on corrupt handouts and sweetheart deals that benefit him and his family.  
  
It’s a slap in the face to Americans who work hard, pay their taxes, and play by the rules.  
  
It is unacceptable.

Wishing the Muslim community in Georgia and across the nation a joyful Eid al-Adha!

Eid Mubarak!

This Supreme Court is setting fire to our democracy.

Video

Here's a quick bit of Civil Rights history from Savannah, Georgia.

Video

On this 6th anniversary, let us honor George Floyd’s memory by recommitting ourselves to building a more just society.

We should never have to choose between justice and public safety. We must do both.
This Memorial Day, we honor every American who has given their life in service to our country. Their bravery and their sacrifice will never be forgotten.

We cannot allow those who are trying to weaponize despair to win. 
  
Do not let them convince you that they have already won.
Donald Trump is trying to save his power at any cost. It will not work.

Instead of voters picking their politicians, the politicians are picking their voters. 
  
It's turning our democracy upside down.

War comes at a cost and we will be paying it for years to come. 
  
The American people have had enough. Let's end this war TODAY.

The President has refused to release his tax returns for years.  
  
Now, he’s using his power to exempt himself from pending tax audits.  
  
What is he hiding?
Our democracy doesn't belong to the politicians; it belongs to the people.

The solution to these attacks on democracy is more democracy.

Video

The President just used his power to exempt himself from pending tax audits. 

He set up a billion dollar slush fund to pay his friends. 

He is directly profiting off of public office to a staggering degree.

The Senate has taken an important step towards ending Trump's illegal war in Iran.

This war has been a failure to the highest degree.

I promise to keep holding this President accountable. My Republican colleagues need to do the same.

Nothing could be more important than passing the Voting Rights Advancement Act. It must be priority number one.

Video

Can’t miss the vote!

Video

What is the President and his family hiding?

Blatant corruption.


The Wall Street Journal (@WSJ)

President Trump’s agreement with the federal government he runs expanded Tuesday to end all pending tax audits of him and his businesses, according to the Justice Department. on.wsj.com/49ZP13k

So that’s what we’ve been praying and working towards for over 200 years? A ballroom?! Thanks for clearing that up. God save us from this foolishness in a serious time.  🙏🏾

I am horrified by the attack at the Islamic Center of San Diego. Bigotry and Islamophobia have no place in America. 

I am praying for the victims and their families. Americans should be safe everywhere they go, especially in places of worship.
